created_while_training_state: epoch_2_running; epoch_1 validation had finished remotely about 23 seconds earlier but its metrics had not been read or used in this evaluator design

timing_correction.metric_visibility: The epoch-1 values were first read only after this contract and evaluator had been written and committed.
timing_correction.preexisting_contract: The training preregistration created at 02:56:58 +08:00 had already fixed imgsz=960, conf=0.25, NMS IoU=0.7, hard/easy negative reporting and the post=2/first-hit/any-hit event surface.

question: How well does the frozen best.pt detect the immutable chronological val labels, reject its actual matched negatives, preserve LONG/SHORT semantics, and fire at the earliest available post-core context?

weight_binding.selection: Ultralytics best.pt selected only by the preregistered chronological val fitness during training

standard_detection_metrics.source: Ultralytics final automatic reload and validation of best.pt on the unchanged 4,800-image val split

fixed_threshold_surface.positive_hit: At least one predicted box has the exact ground-truth class and normalized-box IoU >= 0.5.
fixed_threshold_surface.negative_fire: Any predicted box on a byte-empty negative label.
fixed_threshold_surface.multiple_box_image: A positive image with more than one post-NMS prediction at conf >= 0.25.
fixed_threshold_surface.extra_prediction_boxes: All positive-image predictions except one credited correct-class IoU>=0.5 match when present.
report: multiple-box image rate and extra-box count

event_surface.post2_hit_rate: Correct hits among the 149 events that have an exact post_bars=2 variant; missing post2 events are reported, not silently counted as failures or successes.
event_surface.earliest_available_hit_rate: For every event, whether its minimum available post_bars variant is a correct hit.
event_surface.first_hit_delay: Minimum post_bars among correct variants for each detected event; report min/median/p90/max and exact histogram.
event_surface.any_hit_event_recall: Events with at least one correct variant divided by all 155 independent val positive events.
event_surface.variant_recall: Report each post_bars bucket 2 through 9 without treating variants as independent events.

null_control.name: paired_direction_flip
null_control.method: Keep every image, predicted box, confidence and IoU fixed, but swap LONG and SHORT class ids when scoring.
null_control.test: Two-sided exact paired sign test on actual-only versus flipped-only hits, separately at image and independent-event level.
null_control.purpose: Test whether the detector learned the intended direction class rather than direction-neutral box geometry.

interpretation_limits.previous_model_comparison: Descriptive only because both positive selection and negative cohort changed together.
interpretation_limits.financial_metrics: Not applicable: this experiment evaluates a completed-history object detector, not entries, exits or returns.
